info.name: Neo4j - HAProxy vs Direct Performance Test
info.description: Runs the same Cypher query against Neo4j's HTTP Query API v2. Point this collection at the 'via-haproxy' or 'direct-baseline' environment to compare response times with and without HAProxy in the path. See performance-testing/README.md in the neo4j-aws-privatelink-443 repo for setup and how to run at scale with Newman.

exec: pm.test('Status code is 202 (Query API v2 accepted)', function () {

request.description: POSTs a parameterized Cypher point-lookup against the :PerfTestPerson dataset (see performance-testing/seed-data.cypher) to the Neo4j Query API v2 endpoint. 'id' is randomized per request (prerequest script) to spread reads across the dataset instead of hammering one cached node. baseUrl comes from the active environment — swap environments to switch between the via-HAProxy path (port 443) and the direct baseline path (port 7473, HAProxy bypassed).
